title: Link Two Units by Hand
prompt: Implement `int cross_unit_total(void)` that calls two of your own functions declared in a header-style block *above* their definitions' use (prototype `int part_a(void); int part_b(void);`) and returns their sum. This is the one-TU rehearsal of the two-object link: declarations satisfy the compiler, definitions satisfy the linker.

tests.name: declarations then definitions
tests.hint: part_a returns 10, part_b returns 20: the prototypes bind calls to definitions exactly as the linker does across objects.
